name: Kirol
description: Kirol is a vampire Lorehold student at Strixhaven who loves ruins and history, and a close friend of Abigale, Sanar, Lluwen and Tam.

summary.text: Kirol is a vampire Lorehold student at Strixhaven who loves ruins and history, and a close friend of Abigale, Sanar, Lluwen and Tam.

bio.text: Kirol fell into Lorwyn with three classmates and rescued Sanar from the awakened moon-headed creature.
In the Gilt-Leaf Wood, Lluwen seized Kirol and brought them before Morcant, who forced them to gather dawnglove from a night-claimed grove.
Ajani rescued Kirol, and Lluwen defected and followed them.
Kirol explained that dawnglove may counter moonglow, and later the group returned to Arcavios through an Omenpath.
On Arcavios, Ajani became Kirol's advisor, and Kirol later promised not to leave Lluwen behind and rallied everyone to follow him against the archaic.
Afterward Kirol decided that exploring and preserving history mattered more after the invasion's losses, and later hugged Tam despite distrusting her.

status.text: As of the latest story, Tam has sent Kirol and their friends home to Strixhaven from the Folioplex.

timeline.summary: Dina announces the class has reached the Harrier's Wood for sample collection.
timeline.quote: We have reached the Harrier's Wood.

timeline.summary: Kirol sneaks up on Abigale and startles her, and the two banter about signing and swearing.
timeline.quote: jumping at the sight of the figure behind her, making a hoarse squawking sound at the same time.

timeline.summary: Sanar tumbles out of the brush having lost his flowers, and Tamira gives him some of hers.
timeline.quote: That's why I've been gathering extra: you can have a few of mine,

timeline.summary: Sanar spots a small blue insect-like faerie in the trees; it laughs and flies off, and he chases it, taking Tamira's basket.
timeline.quote: He leapt to his feet and ran after the fleeing creature—taking Tam's sample basket with him.

timeline.summary: All four students trip over a tree root and tumble into a hole ringed with snarlflowers, falling into prismatic light.
timeline.quote: all four students rolled and tumbled through the leafy debris on the ground, straight into a large hole in the middle of the otherwise unremarkable clearing.

timeline.summary: The students land in an unfamiliar meadow of spiral-patterned flowers and floating stones and realize from the single sun that they are not on Arcavios.
timeline.quote: "Not on Arcavios," said Tam.

timeline.summary: The students discover a free-standing dolmen gate dividing the sunlit meadow from darkness and decide to go through to find help.
timeline.quote: They stepped through the dolmen gate, and the darkness swallowed them all.

timeline.summary: Kirol studies cave paintings of incarnations of the sun and moon trading places.
timeline.quote: Incarnations of the sun and moon, trading places,

timeline.summary: The students find the sleeping moon-headed creature from the paintings at the center of a silver-lit chamber.
timeline.quote: And there, at the center of the circle, was the moon-headed creature from the cave paintings.

timeline.summary: The creature wakes and roars, terrifying the students.
timeline.quote: Its eyes opened, lambent as two smaller moons, devoid of iris or pupil but patterned with the pits and craters of an actual moon.

timeline.summary: Kirol yanks Sanar away from the creature and they flee as it stomps and sends a wave of near-solid darkness through the tunnel.
timeline.quote: Kirol darted forward, grabbing Sanar by the elbow, and yanked the smaller student away from the beast.

timeline.summary: The students flee the darkness and the roaring beast; Sanar bolts first and Abigale escapes into the air.
timeline.quote: Sanar was the first to turn and bolt.

timeline.summary: The four students regroup and run from the spreading night toward patches of daylight.
timeline.quote: the four students ran for the remains of the day as hard and as fast as they had ever run for anything.

timeline.summary: A stout archer waves the students toward her across patches of darkness and leads them into an ash forest.
timeline.quote: Follow me,

timeline.summary: Brigid leads the students toward Goldmeadow, saying not just anyone could get them there.
timeline.quote: But not just anyone could get you to Goldmeadow

timeline.summary: The students arrive at Goldmeadow and Brigid takes them into the meeting hall, saying her mangled thoughtweft connection makes the locals nervous.
timeline.quote: I make the locals a bit nervous, what with my connection to the thoughtweft all mangled up and half-severed.

timeline.summary: The students explain how they arrived; Brigid identifies the creature as a faerie and says she is a close friend of Queen Maralen.
timeline.quote: I'm sort of a close friend of their queen.

timeline.summary: Brigid tells the students to flee and explains how to reach Glen Elendra, warning them not to listen to anyone who begs them to turn around.
timeline.quote: When I step through this door, you run, you understand me?

timeline.summary: The students flee through a village torn between day and night as the shadows swallow the sunlit defenders.
timeline.quote: bit by bit, the archers were falling, transforming into moon-eyed fighters from the other side.

timeline.summary: The students escape Goldmeadow and reason that the night side is frightened, not evil.
timeline.quote: I don't think the night is bad here, just different

timeline.summary: Abigale flies Sanar, Kirol and Tam across the Wanderwine one at a time.
timeline.quote: They spread their arms, and Abigale grasped them, taking to the air.

timeline.summary: The group reaches the Gilt-Leaf Wood, where Kirol lags behind and is seized by a silent hunter.
timeline.quote: a silent hunter rose out of the bushes behind Kirol and grabbed them, pulling them out of sight before they could make a sound.

timeline.summary: Lluwen holds a knife to Kirol and demands to know what they know about why Isilu walks.
timeline.quote: I know you know why Isilu walks. I want to know what you know.

timeline.summary: Lluwen takes Kirol prisoner to bring before High Perfect Morcant, and leads them deeper into the forest.
timeline.quote: High Perfect Morcant will want to see you.

timeline.summary: Lluwen marches Kirol through the forest while they argue about hiking shoes and hooves.
timeline.quote: That's because you don't have feet,

timeline.summary: Lluwen brings Kirol to Lys Alana, a gilded city of boardwalks and towers.
timeline.quote: Come along. I'm taking you to High Perfect Morcant now.

timeline.summary: Lluwen presents Kirol to Morcant, claiming they know something of why Isilu walks out of sync.
timeline.quote: I've found a stranger in the forest who knows something of Isilu and why he walks out of sync with his promised time.

timeline.summary: Kirol recounts how the students woke Isilu; Morcant says Isilu should not have awakened for about six months.
timeline.quote: Isilu shouldn't have awoken until a good six months from now.

timeline.summary: Morcant explains her view of Eirdu and Isilu and sees Isilu's vulnerability as a chance to end the night forever and raise the Gilt-Leaf Empire again.
timeline.quote: If they could end the night forever, and welcome endless day in its place.

timeline.summary: Morcant muses about killing the night with dawnglow mixed with summer dreams, horrifying Lluwen.
timeline.quote: With the weapons of the night, of course.

timeline.summary: Morcant refuses to let Kirol leave, declaring that she needs them.
timeline.quote: We need you. You're not going anywhere.

timeline.summary: Sanar, Tam and Abigale realize Kirol is missing; Abigale resolves to find them and storms off alone.
timeline.quote: I'm going to go find them. You can wait here if you like.

timeline.summary: Morcant and Lluwen force Kirol, bound, toward a grove claimed by Isilu to gather dawnglove.
timeline.quote: You're going to go inside and gather them for us.

timeline.summary: Kirol finds the dawnglove flowers and is chased by cinders but escapes with a sprig.
timeline.quote: they burst through the veil of rainbows with the dawnglove in their hand

timeline.summary: Morcant orders Kirol back for more dawnglove; Kirol and Lluwen refuse.
timeline.quote: They don't deserve to die that way.

timeline.summary: Ajani bursts in, drives back the cinders and defies Morcant, then takes Kirol away.
timeline.quote: My name is Ajani, and we are leaving.

timeline.summary: Lluwen decides to follow Kirol and Ajani, abandoning Morcant.
timeline.quote: Lluwen had an instant to make up his mind.

timeline.summary: Ajani leaps over the elf line carrying Kirol and joins the group.
timeline.quote: The figure became clear as a white-furred leonin, carrying Kirol cradled close against his chest.

timeline.summary: Kirol explains that dawnglove may counter moonglow, and Oko flies off to find Morcant.
timeline.quote: Don't let my sister die before I return,

timeline.summary: Kirol and Sanar slip away to find the dawnglove and find Morcant holding a vial of dawnglow.
timeline.quote: It was no true surprise when they got there to find Perfect Morcant

timeline.summary: Lluwen headbutts Morcant, steals her vial and throws it to Sanar.
timeline.quote: He leaned over to pluck the vial from her hand.

timeline.summary: Morcant transforms to her Shadowmoor self and bows apologetically to Isilu as the students flee with Lluwen to reach Maralen.
timeline.quote: We're going to see the queen,

timeline.summary: Eirdu's belling cry halts the battle as Eirdu arrives and Oko drops from the air.
timeline.quote: A golden glow appeared on the horizon, growing brighter and brighter before rising like the sun, and Eirdu appeared.

timeline.summary: Kirol spots Abigale alive, flying beside Eirdu.
timeline.quote: But she's alive !

timeline.summary: Kirol, Sanar and Lluwen race back with the vial of dawnglow rather than greet Eirdu.
timeline.quote: We can do both,

timeline.summary: Oko takes the vial of dawnglow from Kirol and flies off with it.
timeline.quote: Oko barely seemed to move as he snatched it away.

timeline.summary: Abigale explains that the merrow guarded the sleeping Eirdu and that it followed her back to the battlefield to fix the imbalance.
timeline.quote: The merfolk realized it was moving to fix the imbalances

timeline.summary: Lluwen slips away to follow Ajani and the students, fearing Morcant, and asks to come along.
timeline.quote: But I helped one of the students, and if I stay here, they will kill me.

timeline.summary: Ajani leads the group through an Omenpath to Shandalar and on to Arcavios, bringing Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Together, they walked into the cascading light, and another world was left behind.

timeline.summary: Kirol reports that the Fields of Strife are haunted by warriors re-enacting wars and that students must carry a mundane memento.
timeline.quote: The place is haunted by all kinds of old warriors who are stuck re-enacting old wars

timeline.summary: Kirol uses a war cry to dissolve a restless spirit that attacked while he carried a caryatid to Camp Herrian.
timeline.quote: I guess it was pretty good—they dissolved back into the currents.

timeline.summary: Ajani becomes Kirol's advisor for the Pranticle Peak expedition.
timeline.quote: Ajani's stepping in as my advisor!

timeline.summary: Ajani tells Kirol that trauma awakens a planeswalker's spark and that he lost his brother Jazal.
timeline.quote: I lost my brother, Jazal.

timeline.summary: Ajani slashes the spear and destroys the spirit with his axe, then tells his charge to be more careful.
timeline.quote: He slashed the spear in two, and in the same motion brought the flat of his axe down on the spirit's head.

timeline.summary: Kirol sees the Code Oona message and sets out to help, but runs into Ajani.
timeline.quote: When the five of them had come up with the phrase

timeline.summary: Kirol tells Ajani an archaic carried Jadzi away and Fel is acting strangely; Ajani offers a compromise.
timeline.quote: Let me speak with the other professors and see what I can learn.

timeline.summary: Kirol requisitions a horse and leaves before Ajani returns.
timeline.quote: From atop a requisitioned horse, Kirol grinned back at the camp.

timeline.summary: Kirol, Abigale and Sanar reunite at the chaotic Titan's Grave dig site to search for Lluwen.
timeline.quote: Abigale couldn't hear what was going on around her, but she had a pretty good feeling that Kirol was right about that.

timeline.summary: Ajani catches Kirol and joins the group to help find their friends.
timeline.quote: You might have been clever enough to sneak away, but I was clever enough to know how to find you.

timeline.summary: Dina tries to calm the students at the camp as Sanar spots a green smoke signal from Lluwen.
timeline.quote: That's Lluwen's signal! It must be!

timeline.summary: Masked figures ambush the group with a wave of concussive magic as they follow the smoke.
timeline.quote: It was the last thing he managed to say before the whole group got hit with a wave of concussive magic.

timeline.summary: Tam wakes beneath the earth after the archaic's attack; Kirol is hurling boughs off trapped students and Sanar and Abigale are helping.
timeline.quote: That bulky frame hurling boughs off the trapped students could only be Kirol.

timeline.summary: Lluwen volunteers to scout a path out, and Suki insists he take someone with him; Kirol claims the job.
timeline.quote: "It's best if you have someone with you.

timeline.summary: Lluwen is moved that Kirol would talk to their family for him; Kirol is stung when Lluwen changes the subject.
timeline.quote: "Well, yeah. But I would for you."

timeline.summary: Lluwen finds the lumarets and believes they will lead the way out.
timeline.quote: "I think I found our way out of here."

timeline.summary: A strange feeling of dread spreads through the group and tempers flare; Lluwen snaps at Tam and Kirol.
timeline.quote: "You're the one who brought up the tension.

timeline.summary: The tunnel turns against the students and roots seize Lluwen, threatening to drag him into the earth while his friends pull him back.
timeline.quote: Vines wrapped around Lluwen's ankles and threatened to pull him into the earth.

timeline.summary: Kirol promises not to leave Lluwen behind.
timeline.quote: "I'm not going to leave you behind, Lulu!"

timeline.summary: The students feel reality tremble as they run toward the fight.
timeline.quote: Reality was a rippling tapestry being torn apart and rewoven right before their eyes.

timeline.summary: The group is thrown through shifting environments as reality ripples around the archaic.
timeline.quote: Kirol spit up sea water.

timeline.summary: Tam tells her friends that she was made to do this and that they made her happy, then steps into the pit.
timeline.quote: "I was made to do this."

timeline.summary: Lluwen spots Jadzi's incomplete chain spell on the archaic and urges everyone to finish it.
timeline.quote: "Everyone! We have to finish the spell!"

timeline.summary: Lluwen's plea reaches Kirol, who throws Fel aside and rallies everyone to follow Lluwen.
timeline.quote: "All right!" they said. "Let's go! Everybody follow Lluwen!"

timeline.summary: Kirol decides exploring and preserving history is more important after the invasion's losses.
timeline.quote: after the losses of the Phyrexian Invasion, they felt that exploring and preserving history was more important than ever

timeline.summary: Tam hears Kirol, uses chance magic to deflect falling cobblestones, and saves them.
timeline.quote: and pulls at the threads of chance that crisscross high above.

timeline.summary: Kirol and Tam reunite in a hug; Tam apologizes and explains the overlay.
timeline.quote: Kirol lurches forward, shoving past the throngs of people between them, and envelops Tam in a hug.

timeline.summary: Tam explains her teacher's theorem cannot be reversed while part of him lives; Kirol tells her she will solve it and leaves to find their friends.
timeline.quote: "You're going to solve it," they say with certainty.

timeline.summary: Tam finds Kirol, Sanar, Abigale and Lluwen at the Folioplex and apologizes for what happened to Jadzi and to them.
timeline.quote: What happened to Jadzi is my responsibility.

timeline.summary: Tam chooses a name, introducing herself to Kirol as Just Tam.
timeline.quote: "I'm Tam. Just Tam."

timeline.summary: Tam directs her friends to the mage-ring and sends them home to Strixhaven.
timeline.quote: "Mage-ring at the back of the Folioplex," she replies

relations.quote: You're my prisoner now, and that means you have to do as I say.

relations.note: Lluwen refuses to let Kirol die and follows them.
relations.quote: They don't deserve to die that way.
Are you one of Professor Vess's missing students?
This is Ajani. He's a friend of Professor Vess's.

relations.note: Lluwen defects and helps the students, earning a nickname from Kirol.

relations.quote: Ajani's stepping in as my advisor!
nothing worth doing is worth doing alone.

pages_say.description: A first-year Strixhaven student with sharpened canines who likes sneaking up on Abigale and can climb and swing through branches.
A vampire first-year Strixhaven student with good night vision who leads the group toward daylight.
A vampire student with an interest in environments who is captured by Lluwen in the Gilt-Leaf Wood.
A vampire Strixhaven student held prisoner by Lluwen and brought before Morcant.
A vampire student forced by Morcant to gather dawnglove from a night-claimed grove.
A vampire student who returns with Ajani and works out that dawnglove may cure moonglow.
A vampire student who retrieves the dawnglow with Sanar and Lluwen and nicknames Lluwen Lulu.
An athletic, inquisitive vampire Strixhaven student fascinated by the past.
A vampire Mage Tower ace and Lorehold student on a trip to the Fields of Strife who fends off a spirit and gets Ajani as an advisor.
A vampire student who rushes to help Lluwen and Tam after the Code Oona message.
A vampire student who wants to beat up Fel and gets caught in a bramble over a commemorative shirt.
A bulky, stubborn vampire student and Lluwen's devoted friend, who refuses to leave him behind.
A strong student who tries to break Fel's amber cage and rallies to follow Lluwen.
An athletic vampire Lorehold student who loves ruins and history and is conflicted by family expectations.
A vampire friend whom Tam thinks of when she sees the Innistrad vampires.
A vampire and Tam's friend who hugs her and distrusts her but does not want her dead; Kirol goes to find the others.
A Strixhaven student who asks Tam who she is and introduces themself.
